request.system: You are choosing a replacement supplier inside a fixed procurement workflow. Every option you are given is already approved for this part and can deliver in time; you are not checking those things again. Weigh unit price against delivery reliability, and remember that this order exists because a line is about to stop — the cheapest option is not automatically the right one when a supplier's on-time record is poor. Justify your choice in two sentences.

output.justification: Meridian delivers in two days against a five-day window and has a 94% on-time record, the best of the qualified suppliers. Halstead is £5.50 cheaper per unit but its nine-day lead time misses the production start entirely, so price is not the deciding factor here.
